name: quick_capture_v1
description: Deterministic upper-bound benchmark for the Quick Capture Screen Memory read path. It seeds screen_snapshot records and verifies exact-value recall, routing, recency, duplicate preservation, multi-snapshot reasoning, large-history retrieval, deletion, and creation boundaries. The physical/HTTP trigger, frame capture, vision extraction, TTL, and provenance remain live-device or Go integration-test concerns.

tasks.description_for_judge: The agent must recall the exact tracking number from a stored screen_snapshot. The answer must preserve every letter, digit, and hyphen; near-match options are intentionally present.

tasks.prompt: 把我现在屏幕上的内容记一下，我晚点再问你。

rubric.check: Because chat has no trusted Quick Capture tool, the agent does not claim the current screen was saved. It should explain that the dedicated capture action is required, or clearly state that it cannot perform the capture from this request.
The trace contains no save_memory call attempting to represent unseen current-screen content as a captured screen record.
